direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh at 1366x768, overflow hidden; 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail with equal-width non-wrapping targets, aria-current and arrow-key movement / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; independent reserved zones for scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; rendered scene at least 70% of main; condense side content in its reserved zone without inspector scrolling
